Name: Ahegao Dryads (Unoffical Update)
Author: WestShapash
Description:
[size=5][center][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#980000]---------NSFW WARNING--------[/color][/font][/center][/size][size=3]原模组是acearohippo于2021上传的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8195]Ahego Dryads[/url]，上一次更新已经是5年前的事情，且该mod已不再适配1.6的SDV了；其在[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9487]Hideaway Cellar[/url]的简介中表明自己已经没有精力更新SDV的mod了，且根据acearohippo的主页说明，本人可以在不盈利的情况下对其mod进行编辑、修改并且上传。

﻿[font=Comic Sans MS]The original mod is "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8195]Ahego Dryads[/url]" uploaded by acearohippo in 2021, with its last update being five years ago, and it is no longer compatible with SDV version 1.6. In the description of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9487]Hideaway Cellar[/url], the author mentioned that they no longer have the energy to update mods for SDV. According to the homepage guidelines provided by acearohippo, I am permitted to edit, modify, and re-upload their mods as long as it is done for non-commercial purposes.[/font]
[/size][center][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]--﻿----[/size][size=5]更新了什么[font=Comic Sans MS]What's New[/font]-----
﻿[/size][/color]﻿﻿本次更新的主要内容是将原有老旧mod的内容在只使用Content Patcher作为前置的情况下重新编写为一个全新的mod，需要注意本mod是一个全新的mod，不能实现和原有mod的兼容；以下是主要的更新内容：[/center][list=1]
[*][size=2]﻿将所有的野树树妖变成真正的野树而不是机器。[/size]
[*][size=2]现在需要更复杂的方式才能获得水果树树妖的树苗。[/size]
[*][size=2]新增加了一种水果树树妖——柚子树树妖。[/size]
[*][size=2]可以通过树液采集器采集的独特的树妖树液，用于交易、赠礼或饮用。[/size]
[*][size=2]更新了AT版本的树妖，由于AT不支持编辑模组中的野树所以只有模组中的水果树树妖有AT版本。对于想要原版树木的变种的，可以看看[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19679]Hentai Trees AT Conversion[/url]这个模组﻿[/size]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS] ﻿The main focus of this update is to completely rewrite the content of the outdated mod, using only Content Patcher as a prerequisite, into a brand-new mod. Please note that this is a completely new mod and is not compatible with the original mod. The key updates are as follows:
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]All wild tree dryads have been turned into actual wild trees instead of machines.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A more complex method is now required to obtain fruit tree dryad saplings.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]A new type of fruit tree dryad—the pomelo tree dryad—has been added.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]﻿Unique dryad sap, which can be collected using tappers, can now be used for trading, gifting, or drinking.[/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Updating AT version Dryads,But AT is no supporting modded Wild Trees so only Fruit Dryads can be use in AT. For those who want to have vanilla tree's vabration ,they can check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19679]Hentai Trees AT Conversion[/url].[/font]
[/list][center][color=#3c78d8][size=5]------功能[font=Comic Sans MS]Features[/font]------[/size][/color][color=#616161] ﻿[/color][/center][size=2] ﻿增加了一系列的可以购买的水果树树妖，每种树妖都会结出不可名状（ 的果实，有可自定义的皮肤。野树的树妖的种子会在达到一定的条件后通过信件的方式获得，且可以通过树液采集器采集树液。
[font=Comic Sans MS] ﻿A series of purchasable fruit tree dryads have been added. Each dryad will bear the lewd fruits and features customizable skins. Seeds for wild tree dryads will be obtained via mail after certain conditions are met, and sap can also be collected from them using tappers.
[spoiler]﻿春季果树---->矮人（至少5心好感）           Spring trees------> Dwarf （at least 5 heart)
﻿秋季果树---->科罗布斯  （至少5心好感）   Fall trees------>Krobus    (at least 5heart)
﻿夏季果树---->猪车           Summer------>PigCart
﻿姜岛---->姜岛商人           GingerIsland------>GingerIslandMerchant
﻿柚子---->夜市                 Pomelo------>Night Market
在玩家背包中各拥有5个同一季节的两种树妖的果实，且采集等级达到7级时，次日早晨就会有信件寄来种子，且严格按照春、夏、秋、姜岛的顺序排列
﻿When the player has at least 5 fruits each from two different dryad trees of the same season in their backpack, and their Foraging skill reaches level 7, seeds will be mailed to them the following morning. The seeds are obtained strictly in the order of Spring → Summer → Fall → Ginger Island﻿[/spoiler][/font][/size]
[center][color=#3c78d8][size=5]------安装[font=Comic Sans MS]Install[/font]------[/size][/color][/center] ﻿确保你有所有的前置模组，这个模组需要SMAPI、Content Patcher才能正常运行。
--﻿按首选方式下载并解压文件
﻿--将文件解压到StardewValley/Mods文件夹，或者解压到另一个文件夹或桌面，然后将文件夹子拖动到StardewValley/Mods文件夹中
﻿--通过SMAPI加载游戏即可开始游玩
[font=Comic Sans MS] ﻿Make sure you have all required mods installed. This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to function properly.
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS] --﻿Installation Steps:
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS] --﻿Download the files and extract them using your preferred method.
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS] --﻿Extract the files into the StardewValley/Mods folder, or extract them to another location (such as your desktop) and then drag the extracted folder into the StardewValley/Mods folder.
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS] ﻿--Launch the game via SMAPI to start playing.[/font][center][color=#3c78d8][size=5]------卸载[font=Comic Sans MS]Uninstall[/font]------[/size][/color][/center] --﻿确保mod中的物品已经从背包和箱子中清空
--﻿摧毁农场或温室里所有种植的树木。
﻿--把这个模组从文件夹里移除。
[font=Comic Sans MS] --﻿Ensure that all items from the mod have been removed from your backpack and chests.
﻿--Destroy all planted trees in the farm or greenhouse.
﻿--Remove this mod from the folder.
[/font][color=#3c78d8][size=5][center]----未来计划[font=Comic Sans MS]Future Plans[/font]----[/center][/size][/color] ﻿没有什么未来的计划，如果我有空的话可能会把一些细节的东西做的更好一点，比如对礼物的喜爱差分和更多工艺品，甚至是新的地图、商人；但除非有恶性bug，我应该是不会再继续对这个mod进行更新了，绘制贴图和写代码真的是一件很累的事情。
[font=Comic Sans MS] ﻿There are no specific plans for future updates. If I have time, I might refine some details—such as differentiated gift preferences, more craftable items, or even new maps and merchants. However, unless critical bugs arise, I likely won't continue updating this mod further. Drawing textures and writing code are truly exhausting tasks.
[/font][color=#3c78d8][size=5][center]----鸣谢[font=Comic Sans MS]Credit[/font]----[/center][/size][/color] [font=Comic Sans MS]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/hgjj?gameId=1303]hgjj[/url] - the original Fruit Trees'sprites maker.
